title: Key points
text: List the key points from [file]

title: Summarize a file
text: Summarize [file] in five bullets, then one sentence on what it means for [audience]

title: Prepare for a review
text: Help me prepare for a review of [file] with [business leadership]: likely questions, weak spots and how to answer them

title: FAQ from a document
text: Create an FAQ based on [file] for [audience]

title: Decisions and open questions
text: List the decisions made and the open questions left in [file], with who owns each

title: What changed
text: Compare [older file] with [newer file] and tell me what changed and why it matters

title: Catch up on a folder
text: Look through my notebook and tell me what was added or changed recently, grouped by topic

title: Explain like I am new
text: Explain [topic] as if I just joined the project: what it is, why it matters and who to talk to

title: Meeting notes to actions
text: Turn these meeting notes into decisions, actions (owner, due date) and risks: [paste notes or file]

title: Draft an email
text: Draft a short email to [recipient] about [topic]. Tone: [friendly / formal]. End with a clear ask.

title: Make it clearer
text: Rewrite this so it is clear and concise for [audience], keeping the meaning: [paste text]

title: Executive summary
text: Write a half-page executive summary of [file] for [sponsor]: situation, what we need, and the decision required

title: Shorten to bullets
text: Turn [paste text or file] into no more than seven plain-language bullets

title: Announcement
text: Write an announcement for [audience] about [change], covering what, when, why and what they need to do

title: Plan a piece of work
text: Break [goal] into phases, tasks and milestones with rough durations, assuming a deadline of [date]

title: Find the risks
text: List the top risks in [file or topic], each with likelihood, impact and a mitigation

title: Status update
text: Draft a status update for [project] from [file]: RAG, progress, next steps, risks and asks

title: Compare options
text: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [goal] in a table: cost, effort, risk and benefits, then recommend one

title: RACI
text: Create a RACI for [activity or project] with roles [roles]

title: User stories
text: Turn [file or notes] into user stories with acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then

title: Find gaps
text: Review [file] for ambiguous, missing or conflicting requirements and suggest wording fixes

title: Questions to ask
text: What questions should I ask [stakeholder] to clarify [topic]?

title: Explain a spreadsheet
text: Explain what is in [workbook]: sheets, what each column means and anything that looks wrong

title: Trends
text: Look at [workbook] and tell me the three biggest trends or outliers, with the cells you used

title: Teach me
text: Teach me the basics of [topic] in ten minutes, with one worked example from my project

title: What can you do
text: What can Lumen help me with on [project or role]? Give examples I can try
